maxPreviewTokens.description: Optional estimated discovery-preview token ceiling. Missing or null on create disables budgeting; PATCH omission preserves the value and null clears it. Estimates use o200k_base over compact preview JSON plus fixed allowances, stored at authoring. The ceiling covers one logical discovery payload; model framing, session history and subsequent content loads are excluded.
